description: List subscription invoices, optionally filtered by store, status, or refunded flag. API: GET /subscription-invoices (filter[store_id], filter[status], filter[refunded]).

include.description: Comma-separated related resources to sideload (JSON:API include=), e.g. 'store,variant'.

page_size.description: Results per page (JSON:API page[size], max 100). Default 10.

status.description: Filter by invoice status (e.g. paid, void, refunded).

store_id.description: Filter to a single store id.

name: lemonsqueezy_list_subscription_invoices
title: List subscription invoices
